subject: Operations

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No retry-with-backoff policy wraps the database connection/query or the OTLP exporter calls

evidence.excerpt: connection.Open(); ... var transaction = connection.BeginTransaction(); ... result = await connection.QueryFirstOrDefaultAsync<int>(command);

findings.recommendation: Wrap the DB connection open/query call in TestingRepository with a Polly retry policy (exponential backoff, small retry count) for transient SqlException/NpgsqlException errors; for the OTLP exporter, confirm/rely on the SDK's own retry behavior rather than assuming it, since none is configured here.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No circuit breaker protects calls to the database or the OpenTelemetry collector
findings.recommendation: Add a Polly circuit-breaker policy around the DB client so repeated failures against a degraded database short-circuit quickly instead of each request re-attempting a full open/transaction/query cycle; verify the OTLP exporter's own degraded-collector behavior doesn't block request threads.

strengths.subject: Operations
strengths.title: Per-data-source connect timeout is explicitly configurable rather than hardcoded

checkResults.subject: Operations
checkResults.reason: A ConnectTimeout is explicitly configured per data source for both SqlServer and PostgreSQL connection strings; the DB command and the OTLP exporter fall back to finite provider/SDK-default timeouts (no indefinite waits observed) even though no timeout is set explicitly on the CommandDefinition or OtlpExporterOptions.

checkResults.subject: Operations
checkResults.reason: No retry policy exists for the DB open/query in TestingRepository or for the OTLP exporter calls in OpenTelemetryExtensions.
